Principal investigator: Christoph Huber, WU Vienna University of Economics and Business

We are asking you to participate in a research study. This form will give you some information about the study. Please read the form carefully before proceeding.

A. Project Description

This study will ask you to make decision(s) with monetary consequences.

  • The estimated time to complete the study is max 15 minutes.
  • The research is being conducted with the goal of publication in academic journals and presentations at academic conferences.
  • Your participation is completely voluntary. You can discontinue your participation at any time before you have handed in your responses. However, once the study is finished, you cannot withdraw your participation.
B. Risks and Benefits

Your participation in this study does not involve any physical or emotional risk to you beyond those of daily life. None of the information presented is designed to be upsetting or offensive in any way. The potential benefit of the study is a better scientific understanding of human decision making.

C. Compensation

You will receive a minimum payment of £1.30 for participation and you can receive additional payments depending on your decisions in the study. To receive any compensation you need to pass one simple attention check and you need to complete the study.

D. Confidentiality

This study is anonymous. Your name and other identifying information will never be attached to your answers. All data collected will be analyzed in aggregate form. Spreadsheets on which the data are entered will contain no identifiable information, the anonymous data will later be posted online indefinitely and the data will thus be available to other researchers. Your privacy will thus be maintained in all published and written data resulting from this study. We follow the European Union’s GDPR rules.

E. Contacts

If you have any questions or concerns about this study, you may use the Prolific message function or contact Christoph Huber at Christoph.Huber@wu.ac.at.
